anchor.quote: A fuel cell system with a cathode subsystem, said cathode subsystem
a cathode inlet line that provides cathode air to the fuel cell stack
a cathode exhaust line that exhausts a cathode exhaust gas out of the fuel cell stack
a backpressure valve in the cathode exhaust line, said backpressure valve located downstream of a drip rail of the cathode exhaust line
the drip rail includes a protrusion that prevents condensed water from building up near the backpressure valve
said drip rail further including a sump that collects drips of condensed water from the protrusion of the drip rail

a controller that is programmed to determine the temperature of the backpressure valve and to estimate the liquid water near the backpressure valve, said controller performing a freeze purge strategy if the temperature and liquid water near the backpressure valve reach predetermined threshold values
a by-pass line that selectively directs cathode inlet air to the cathode exhaust line using a by-pass valve
said by-pass valve located near the cathode inlet line in the by-pass line
said by-pass line including at least one turn downstream of the by-pass valve that prevents water in the cathode exhaust line from back splashing against the by-pass valve
a charge air cooler and a water vapor transfer unit in the cathode inlet line
the charge air cooler is located in the cathode inlet line and feeds into the water vapor transfer unit in the cathode inlet line
said charge air cooler being cooled by a coolant loop

a pressure sensor is positioned on the charge air cooler such that the pressure of the cathode inlet air is measured after the air is cooled by the charge air cooler and the pressure of the cathode inlet air is measured before the water vapor transfer unit adds water to the cathode inlet air
a drain that is directly below the water vapor transfer unit, said drain including a sump that drains liquid water from the water vapor transfer unit into the cathode exhaust line through an orifice
a screen that sits in the drain directly above the orifice

a portion of the drain that includes the orifice and the screen extends into the cathode exhaust line such that heat from the cathode exhaust line is able to melt ice that may accumulate at the orifice of the drain
the portion of the drain that is near the screen and the orifice is made of a thermally conductive material
the backpressure valve is an inverted P-valve that is located in a hill region of the cathode exhaust line
